title: 2D scene or environment
description: Wide environment or scene image (location, backdrop, establishing shot); feeds art2d scene and environment artifacts.

guidance: Name the place, time of day and mood before details.
Name the camera (wide establishing shot, eye level or elevated three-quarter view) and the depth layers (foreground, midground, background).
Keep one focal area and a clear read for the eye, no characters unless the brief asks for them.

prompt_rubric: The prompt names one clear subject and its role in the game.
The prompt states the style, framing and background the purpose requires.
The prompt contains no text, logos, watermarks or real-world brands to render unless the purpose asks for them.
The prompt avoids contradictions (for example transparent background and a full scene).
The prompt names the location, the camera and the depth layers (foreground, midground, background).
image_rubric: The image shows the subject the prompt asked for, without extra subjects.
The style matches the style preset; no mixed rendering styles.
No unwanted text, watermark, signature or frame.
No anatomical, perspective or structural errors that block the target use.
The focal area and the depth layers read at thumbnail size.
Perspective and horizon are consistent across the scene.
